name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A shadcn/ui drawer built on scrollsheet instead of vaul. Same Drawer/DrawerTrigger/DrawerContent/DrawerTitle/DrawerDescription/DrawerClose API you already know, plus DrawerHandle, but backed by a native <dialog> and CSS scroll-snap instead of pointer-event gesture simulation. Zero runtime dependencies beyond scrollsheet itself.
author: Ansuman Shah <https://github.com/ansumanshah>
